name: Email Template Suite
description: A comprehensive suite of email templates managed by the Head of Marketing for use by Customer Service Staff and the Support Team. This document serves as the master repository for standardized customer email communications.
context: Audience | Customer Service Staff, Support Team

name: Account Opening Confirmation
description: An email template sent to new customers to notify them that their SmartSaver account is open and ready for use. It provides essential account details, next steps for onboarding, and current interest rate information.
context: Subject: Your FirstUK Bank Account Is Ready! 🎉
Your SmartSaver account with FirstUK Bank is now open and ready to use.

name: Customer Name
description: A placeholder for the full name of the customer receiving the account opening confirmation.

name: Account Number
description: A placeholder for the unique account number assigned to the customer's new SmartSaver account.

name: Current Balance
description: A placeholder for the initial or current monetary balance of the account at the time of confirmation.

name: SmartSaver
description: A banking product offered by FirstUK Bank that earns interest (4.50% AER) and is the subject of the account opening confirmation template.
context: Your SmartSaver account with FirstUK Bank is now open
you're earning 4.50% AER on your SmartSaver

name: New SmartSaver Account
description: The specific customer account being opened and confirmed via the communication template.
context: Your SmartSaver account with FirstUK Bank is now open and ready to use.

name: New Customer
description: The recipient of the account opening confirmation email who has just joined FirstUK Bank.
context: Welcome to FirstUK Bank! We're delighted to have you.

name: Interest Payment Notification
description: A monthly notification email sent to customers to inform them that interest has been credited to their account. It provides a breakdown of the interest calculation, the current AER, and tiered rate incentives for higher balances.
context: Your monthly interest has been added to your account.
If you'd like to increase your rate, consider depositing more

name: Customer Name
description: The dynamic placeholder for the recipient's full name used in the email salutation.

name: Interest Amount
description: The specific monetary value of the interest payment being credited to the account, appearing in both the subject line and the details section.

name: Account Balance
description: The balance used as the basis for the interest calculation.

name: Calculation Days
description: The number of days in the period for which interest was calculated.

name: Effective Date
description: The date on which the interest payment was applied to the account.

name: New Balance
description: The total account balance after the interest payment has been added.

name: Interest-Bearing Account
description: A customer account that earns interest based on tiered AER rates (4.50% to 4.80%) depending on the balance.
context: Your monthly interest has been added to your account.
Your Current Rate: 4.50% AER (applies to balances £0–£10,000)

name: Interest Recipient
description: An existing bank customer who holds an interest-bearing account and is the recipient of the monthly payment notification.
context: Thank you for banking with us!

name: Template 3: Rate Change Notification
description: An email template used to notify customers when their interest rate has been updated following a change in the Bank of England base rate. It explains the reason for the change, provides the new rate, and offers an example calculation of the impact on monthly interest.
context: Subject: Your Interest Rate Has Changed
The Bank of England has changed its base rate, and your FirstUK Bank interest rate has been updated.
Your SmartSaver rate is variable, which means it moves with the Bank of England base rate.

name: Customer Name
description: A placeholder for the recipient's full name used in the greeting of the Rate Change Notification.

name: Old Interest Rate
description: A placeholder for the interest rate applied to the account prior to the current update.

name: New Interest Rate
description: A placeholder for the updated interest rate being applied to the customer's account.

name: Effective Date
description: A placeholder for the date on which the new interest rate becomes active.

name: New Monthly Interest Amount
description: A placeholder used in the example calculation to show the customer the estimated monthly interest they will earn under the new rate.

name: SmartSaver
description: A variable-rate savings account that tracks the Bank of England base rate with a fixed 2.5% margin.
context: Your SmartSaver rate is variable, which means it moves with the Bank of England base rate.

name: Fixed Rate Bonds
description: A fixed-rate product recommended to customers who prefer stability over variable rates, scheduled for release in 2026.
context: If you'd prefer a fixed rate, we recommend our Fixed Rate Bonds (coming 2026).

name: FirstUK Bank Customer
description: The recipient of the rate change notification who holds a variable rate account.
context: Thank you for being a FirstUK Bank customer.

name: Template 4: Successful Transfer Confirmation
description: An email template sent to customers to confirm that a fund transfer has been successfully processed. It provides a summary of the transaction details, the updated account balance, and instructions for reporting unauthorized activity.
context: Your transfer has been successfully processed.

name: Transfer Amount
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the specific monetary value of the transfer being confirmed.

name: Customer Name
description: A dynamic placeholder for the name of the bank customer receiving the confirmation email.

name: Account Identifier
description: A dynamic placeholder representing the masked account number of the sender's SmartSaver account.

name: Recipient Name
description: A dynamic placeholder for the name of the person or entity receiving the funds.

name: Recipient Bank
description: A dynamic placeholder for the name of the receiving financial institution.

name: Transfer Date and Time
description: A dynamic placeholder indicating when the transfer was executed.

name: New Account Balance
description: A dynamic placeholder showing the remaining balance in the customer's account after the transfer has been deducted.
context: Your New Balance: £[new balance] (after this transfer)

name: SmartSaver
description: A specific banking product used as the source of funds in the transfer confirmation template.

name: Individual Customer
description: The recipient of the transfer confirmation email who holds a SmartSaver account.
context: If you didn't authorize this transfer or have concerns, contact us immediately

name: SmartSaver Account
description: The specific account from which funds are being transferred in the confirmation template.

name: Successful Fund Transfer
description: A completed financial transfer event that triggers the sending of the confirmation template.
context: Your transfer has been successfully processed.

name: Failed Transaction Notification
description: An email template used to notify customers when a transfer has failed. It provides specific reasons for the failure (insufficient funds, invalid account, or closed account) and offers tailored solutions for each scenario.
context: Your transfer of £[amount] to [recipient] could not be completed.
Reason: [Insufficient funds / Invalid account / Account closed / Other]

name: Customer Name
description: A placeholder for the name of the customer receiving the notification.

name: Transfer Amount
description: A placeholder for the monetary value of the failed transaction.
context: Your transfer of £[amount] to [recipient] could not be completed.

name: Recipient
description: A placeholder for the name or identifier of the intended recipient of the funds.
context: Your transfer of £[amount] to [recipient] could not be completed.

name: Failure Reason
aliases: [Insufficient funds / Invalid account / Account closed / Other]
description: A dynamic field indicating the specific cause of the transaction failure.
context: Reason: [Insufficient funds / Invalid account / Account closed / Other]

name: Reason Explanation
description: A placeholder for a detailed explanation of the failure, tailored to the specific reason selected.

name: Reason Solution
description: A placeholder for the recommended next steps or solution, tailored to the specific reason for failure.

name: Current Balance
description: A placeholder for the customer's current account balance, used specifically in the insufficient funds scenario.

name: Shortfall Amount
description: A placeholder for the additional amount required to complete the transfer in the event of insufficient funds.

name: Recipient Account Number
description: A placeholder for the incorrect account number provided by the customer in the invalid account scenario.

name: Customer
description: The bank customer who is the recipient of the failed transaction notification.
context: Your transfer of £[amount] to [recipient] could not be completed.

name: Customer Account
description: The account from which the customer attempted to transfer funds.
context: The transfer failed because your account balance is too low.

name: Failed Transfer
description: A financial transfer event that could not be completed due to various errors or insufficient funds.
context: Your transfer of £[amount] to [recipient] could not be completed.
The transfer failed because your account balance is too low.

name: Template 6: Card Replacement Confirmation
description: A customer notification template used to confirm that a replacement debit or credit card has been issued and is in transit. It provides card details, explains the status of the old card, and provides activation instructions.
context: Your replacement card has been issued and is on its way.
When it arrives, activate it by logging into your account at www.firstuk.bank/login and clicking "Activate Card."

name: Customer Name
description: A placeholder for the full name of the customer receiving the replacement card.

name: Card Type
description: A placeholder specifying whether the replacement card is a debit or credit card.

name: Last 4 Digits
description: A placeholder for the last four digits of the new card number for identification purposes.

name: Replacement Reason
description: A placeholder indicating the reason why the card replacement was triggered.

name: Estimated Arrival
description: A placeholder for the expected delivery timeframe of the replacement card.

name: Customer
description: The recipient of the card replacement confirmation who is awaiting a new physical card.
context: Your replacement card has been issued and is on its way.

name: Replacement Card
description: The physical payment card (Debit or Credit) being issued to the customer to replace a previous one.
context: Your replacement card has been issued and is on its way.
Your old card is blocked and can no longer be used.

name: Template 7: Complaint Acknowledgment
description: A formal acknowledgment communication sent to customers after a complaint has been received. It provides a reference number, sets expectations for the investigation timeline (8 calendar days), and informs the customer of their right to escalate to the Financial Ombudsman Service.
context: We will respond with our findings within 8 calendar days
If you're unhappy with our response, you have the right to escalate to the Financial Ombudsman Service

name: Customer Name
description: A placeholder for the full name of the customer who submitted the complaint.

name: Complaint Reference Number
description: A unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to the specific complaint for tracking and reference purposes.

name: Date and Time Received
description: The timestamp indicating exactly when the bank received the customer's complaint.

name: Investigator Name
description: The name of the staff member assigned to investigate and resolve the customer's complaint.

name: Complaint Recipient
description: The bank customer who has filed a complaint and is the recipient of the acknowledgment template.
context: Thank you for bringing this matter to our attention.

name: Template 8: Complaint Resolution
description: An email template used to communicate the outcome of a complaint investigation to a customer. It includes the investigation findings, the bank's decision, the resolution action, and instructions for escalating the matter to the Financial Ombudsman Service.
context: We have completed our investigation into your complaint dated [date].
If You Disagree With Our Decision: You have the right to escalate to the Financial Ombudsman Service

name: Customer Name
description: A placeholder for the full name of the customer receiving the complaint resolution notification.

name: Complaint Reference
description: A unique identifier for the specific complaint case, used in the subject line and body of the email.

name: Complaint Date
description: The date on which the customer originally submitted their complaint.
context: We have completed our investigation into your complaint dated [date].

name: Investigation Findings Summary
description: A dynamic text field providing a summary of what the bank discovered during the investigation of the complaint.
context: What We Found: [Summary of investigation findings]

name: Decision Outcome
description: The formal decision reached by the bank regarding the complaint, categorized as upheld, partially upheld, or rejected.

name: Resolution Action
description: The specific action the bank is taking to resolve the complaint, such as issuing a refund or providing an explanation.

name: Resolution Details
aliases: [Specific details of resolution - refund amount, dates, etc.]
description: Detailed information regarding the resolution, including specific monetary amounts or relevant dates.
context: Details: [Specific details of resolution - refund amount, dates, etc.]

name: Refund Timeframe
description: The expected period of time before a refund appears in the customer's account.
context: Your refund (if applicable) has been processed and will appear in your account within [timeframe].

name: Complaint Recipient
description: The bank customer who has filed a complaint and is receiving the resolution notification.
context: We have completed our investigation into your complaint

name: Template 9: Password Reset Confirmation
description: A security notification sent to customers to confirm that their online banking password has been successfully reset. It provides security reminders and urgent contact instructions if the reset was unauthorized.
context: Your online banking password has been successfully reset.
If you didn't reset your password, contact us immediately

name: Customer Name
description: A dynamic placeholder used to personalize the password reset confirmation email with the recipient's name.

name: Bank Customer
description: The recipient of the password reset confirmation who holds an online banking account with FirstUK Bank.
context: Your online banking password has been successfully reset.

name: Template 10: KYC Document Request
description: A customer-facing communication template used to request necessary identity and address documentation to complete the Know Your Customer (KYC) account verification process. It outlines acceptable documents, submission methods, and a specific deadline for compliance.
context: Subject: Action Needed: Please Provide Your Identity Documents
We need you to provide some documentation to complete your account verification (KYC - Know Your Customer).

name: Customer Name
description: A dynamic placeholder used to personalize the KYC document request by inserting the specific customer's name.

name: Submission Deadline Date
description: A dynamic placeholder specifying the date by which the customer must submit their KYC documentation, typically set to 30 days from the request date.

name: KYC Request Recipient
description: The bank customer who is required to provide identity and address verification documents to satisfy regulatory requirements.
context: We need you to provide some documentation to complete your account verification

name: Customer Account for Verification
description: The customer account that is currently undergoing the KYC verification process to ensure regulatory compliance.
context: complete your account verification (KYC - Know Your Customer)

name: KYC Document Collection Process
description: The process of collecting identity documents (Passport or Driving License) and address verification (Utility bill, Council tax letter, or Bank statement) from the customer.
context: complete your account verification (KYC - Know Your Customer)
Choose one: - UK Passport (copy is fine) - UK Driving License (copy is fine) PLUS one of these for your address: - Utility bill (dated within 3 months) - Council tax letter - Bank statement

name: Regulatory KYC Documentation Requirement
description: The mandatory requirement for the bank to collect specific identity and address documentation from customers to meet regulatory standards for responsible banking.
context: Regulatory requirements ensure we're banking responsibly and protecting your account.
We need you to provide some documentation to complete your account verification

name: Template 11: Account Closure Confirmation
description: A formal communication sent to customers to confirm the closure of their FirstUK Bank account. It provides final balance details, payout methods, and notifies the customer of the cancellation of associated services like online banking and cards.
context: Your FirstUK Bank account has been closed, effective [date].
All standing orders and Direct Debits have been canceled
Your online banking access has been deactivated

name: Customer Name
description: A placeholder for the full name of the customer whose account is being closed.

name: Closure Date
description: The specific date on which the account closure becomes effective.
context: Your FirstUK Bank account has been closed, effective [date].

name: Account Number
description: The unique identifier for the bank account being closed.

name: Final Balance Amount
description: The remaining monetary balance in the account at the time of closure.

name: Final Interest Amount
description: The amount of interest accrued and payable upon account closure.

name: Fees Applied Amount
description: Any fees charged to the account during the closure process.

name: Net Payout Amount
description: The final total amount to be paid out to the customer after interest and fees.

name: Payout Method
aliases: [Selected method: transfer to new bank / cheque / cash at branch]
description: The chosen method for delivering the final balance to the customer.
context: [Selected method: transfer to new bank / cheque / cash at branch]

name: Payout Timeframe
description: The expected duration for the customer to receive their final balance.

name: Transaction ID
description: The unique reference number associated with the final payout transaction.

name: Customer
description: The bank customer who is the recipient of the account closure confirmation and whose account is being terminated.
context: Your FirstUK Bank account has been closed

name: FirstUK Bank Account
description: The specific bank account held by the customer that is the subject of the closure process.
context: Your FirstUK Bank account has been closed

name: Customer Payment Card
description: The payment card issued to the customer which becomes invalid upon account closure.
context: Your card (if issued) is no longer valid
